posts.tagline: Know if your Reddit post will stay up — before you post
posts.description: PostGuard scores your Reddit draft against the subreddit's rules, your karma and account age — then keeps checking from a signed-out view after you publish, to catch the removals nobody tells you about. It never posts, votes or comments for you.

posts.name: EffectDeck
posts.tagline: Effects for any player on your iPhone
posts.description: Android has RootlessJamesDSP — system-wide audio effects without root. iOS had nothing. Not a worse version. Nothing. AUv3 only runs inside a DAW, EQ apps only touch their own player. iOS 27 cracked it open: an app can now present itself as an audio output device. Pick EffectDeck in Control Center and everything you play goes through your chain — Spotify, YouTube, podcasts, anything. 100+ effects from EffeTune's DSP core. IR reverb, analyzers, a 16x16 matrix. Free, no account, no ads.

posts.name: Loopdraw
posts.tagline: The PDF editor that edits the actual text
posts.description: Loopdraw is a free online PDF editor. Edit the words on the page in the document’s own type. Sign it, draw on it, reorder it, convert it. Most of it runs in your browser.

posts.name: Betterswitch
posts.tagline: A native macOS window switcher built for productivity
posts.description: Betterswitch is a fast macOS window switcher that brings every open window into reach. Switch directly between windows, apps, and workspaces.

posts.name: Rally
posts.tagline: Play games. Hang out. Rally together.
posts.description: Play free online multiplayer mini games with friends. Create a private room, share the link, and compete in quick live games for 2–4 players.

posts.name: QR Code Pro
posts.tagline: Free QR codes: links, Wi-Fi, contacts, email. No account.
posts.description: QR Code Pro makes a QR code in seconds, on your phone, with nothing to sign up for. Pick a type — link, plain text, Wi-Fi network, contact card (vCard) or pre-filled email — fill in the fields, and the code appears instantly. Change its colors and pattern, save it to Photos or share it straight from the app. Free, no account, no subscription. A one-time Pro unlock (€2.99) removes the watermark and the ads and lifts the history limit. Built by an indie developer in France, in French and English.

posts.name: Syllbi
posts.tagline: Syllabi for everything
posts.description: Syllbi is a free iOS app for exploring an artist's catalog, a franchise, or a genre as a branching guide instead of a flat list: start at one entry point and follow whichever connection matches what you actually want next. It already ships with guides across books, film, TV, music, games, and comics.

posts.name: PulseKit
posts.tagline: Any number, on your phone, with real iPhone push
posts.description: A finished Cloudflare Workers kit: watch any JSON endpoint, chart it, and get real push notifications on your iPhone. Runs on the $5 Workers plan.

posts.name: ResilAI
posts.tagline: Deterministic incident readiness & ops safety for SMBs
posts.description: ResilAI answers one question every morning: "Can this organization safely operate today?" We collect telemetry from security tools, IAM, and backups to calculate a deterministic Governance Health Index (GHI) mapped to NIST CSF 2.0. LLMs are strictly forbidden from calculating scores; Gemini only translates findings into plain-English business risks and single high-ROI fixes.

posts.name: MessyDev
posts.tagline: AI is messy. Learn what it’s doing while you build.
posts.description: Learn AI the way it actually works: prompts, context, APIs and agents, guided room by room by Messy. Same AI. A clearer you.

posts.name: The Marketing Arena
posts.tagline: Turn your marketing routine into a game
posts.description: Pledge the marketing tasks you mean to do, each on their own schedule, then answer for them as they are due. Gain XP for committing evidence to the pledges you make and progress through the levels. Missed days cost health, and at zero you are out of the arena.

posts.name: TradoBiz
posts.tagline: Run your business on one system — not on Excel and WhatsApp.
posts.description: TradoBiz brings your customers, stock, orders, quotations and billing into one place — with real Tally and Xero sync. 7-day free trial, no card needed.

posts.name: PharmD.AI
posts.tagline: AI medication answers, with real pharmacists when needed
posts.description: PharmD.AI combines 24/7 AI medication answers with licensed pharmacist review for questions that need professional judgment. Check drug interactions, understand side effects, build medication schedules, and turn hospital discharge instructions into a clear plan. Get answers in 9 languages and find pharmacy savings—all in one place. Available on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Website Auditor 2.0: AI Search
posts.tagline: See if ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity cite your brand
posts.description: We’re back with a massive update built for the AI search era! Since our first launch, we've added: • AI Visibility Scoring: Track if ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude are actually citing your brand. • Go-To-Market plan: sign up for Pro to get a 90 day plan to become visible • MCP Integration: Built for seamless developer workflows. Try the new tools and let us know what you think!

posts.name: AI Business Partner
posts.tagline: $19 AI diagnostic audits & 90-day growth plan for DTC brands
posts.description: AI Business Partner provides instant, evidence-based diagnostic audits and 90-day growth strategies for e-commerce brands—with zero login required. Powered by DeepSeek R1 and behavioral economics (JTBD, Friction Theory), it analyzes observable storefront signals to identify primary growth constraints. Run a free search to reveal your store's diagnosis, then unlock a complete 90-day execution roadmap and ICE-prioritized action plan for a one-time payment of $19.

posts.name: Chessora
posts.tagline: Can you beat AI in Chess?
posts.description: Chessora makes it simple to play chess against a powerful AI opponent. Choose your difficulty, start a game instantly, and improve your skills through real gameplay. No waiting for an opponent, no complicated setup.

posts.name: NexusAI OS
posts.tagline: B2B artificial-intelligence operating system
posts.description: NexusAI OS is a unified B2B artificial-intelligence operating system that brings 50 specialized modules across engineering, finance, compliance, logistics, talent, security, and enterprise marketplaces into one modular workspace.

posts.name: CODDX Software
posts.tagline: The science behind next-gen mobile apps & games
posts.description: CODDX is a global technology hub and mobile app studio building and scaling high-performance consumer applications and games. Powered by proprietary deep tech from the CODDX AI Lab and advanced algorithmic user acquisition, our ecosystem features cutting-edge products including Atama 360, Peer2Safe, Sanal Kabin, Form Optimum, and Tile Move. In addition to in-house apps, we actively partner with developers through publishing and investments.

posts.name: Motqn AI - Teachers Destination for AI
posts.tagline: Lesson plans, slides & tests from your curriculum in seconds
posts.description: Motqn is an AI assistant built for teachers. Upload your textbook or curriculum, and it instantly generates curriculum-aligned lesson plans, interactive PowerPoint presentations with images, and ready-to-export tests with adjustable difficulty, then grades and evaluates them automatically. With Tabshoura Plus, you get a voice-based assistant for real-time conversation, shared whiteboard collaboration, and generating presentations and tests as you talk.
